opening.argument: The presentation leads with an easy monetary-return promise: “1 Survey = ₹100 | Free PayTM Cash,” reinforced by the statement that “one survey will reach to 100 rupees.” It then directs viewers toward account creation through an external YouGov referral link while demonstrating the steps for obtaining the advertised benefit. Those steps include changing the country setting so the Paytm option appears, entering survey information, answering questions randomly, and working through multiple accounts. The displayed survey, Paytm, and transaction-history material supports the promoted process, but it does not establish eligibility, transaction authenticity, successful payment, or the result of following the referral. The combination of a low-barrier reward claim and instructions for pursuing it therefore presents the offer without proving that viewers can actually obtain the promised benefit.
